summary: Quantum Leap Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the partial exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option for its IPO. 917,392 additional units were purchased at $10.00 per unit on May 12, 2026, raising $9.17M in gross proceeds. Post-closing, $211.3M is held in the trust account. No business combination, tender offer, or other special situation is announced. This is a routine post-IPO update.
